tasks.title: Add a delete method to ProfileDao
tasks.description: delete a profile record from the database, following the same pattern as insert()
acceptance_criteria: ProfileDao gets a suspend fun delete(profile: Profile) annotated with @Delete

tasks.title: Add a count query to ProfileDao
tasks.description: return the total number of profiles, following the same @Query pattern as getById
acceptance_criteria: ProfileDao gets a suspend fun count(): Int annotated with a @Query that counts rows
tasks.pattern_example:
@Query("SELECT * FROM profile WHERE id = :id")
    suspend fun getById(id: Long): Profile?
tasks.exact_code:
@Query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM profile")
    suspend fun count(): Int

tasks.title: Add a deleteById query to ProfileDao
tasks.description: delete a profile by its id, following the same parameterized @Query pattern used by getById, but as a DELETE statement
acceptance_criteria: ProfileDao gets a suspend fun deleteById(id: Long) annotated with a @Query DELETE statement
tasks.pattern_example:
@Query("SELECT * FROM profile ORDER BY name ASC")
    fun getAll(): Flow<List<Profile>>
tasks.exact_code:
@Query("DELETE FROM profile WHERE id = :id")
    suspend fun deleteById(id: Long)
